text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Today, we're going to take a deep dive 
into Win Variation-san!

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of her, people often talked about 
her clashes against Orfevre, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text:
If anything, the image was that of chasing 
after Orfevre, but... her performance in 
the Arima Kinen was magnificent!

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text:
I even see people describing her as having 
surpassed Orfevre, who defined an entire 
era—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "Surpassed"...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you not satisfied with this?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...When I won that 'Arima Kinen', I truly 
felt like I was the star. But—"

text_block_list.name: Newly Enrolled Sion
text_block_list.text:
Must be nice, that's so amazing, so 
amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
As for whether I managed to surpass 
someone who shines like Orfe-san...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I can't feel that way at all. It still 
feels so, so far away.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate... I feel like I'll just be 
chasing after them forever and ever."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Is it really okay for me to stay like 
this?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: It's fine just the way it is!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Doto-san!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Haua! I-I'm so sorry! I overheard you and 
just couldn't help but whoaa...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...In the Twinkle Series, Dotou-san is 
Opera O-san's rival—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if something happened that made 
her feel, "This is fine as it is"?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Wha!? Ah, ummm...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
O... Opera O-san is... someone I've 
admired ever since the day we met-desu.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Always a sparkling, brilliant sun, so 
dignified, so cool, and so strong!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The reason I grew strong enough to be 
called a rival like that is all thanks to 
Opera O-san—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Someone once told me this.

text_block_list.name: Opera O's Fan
text_block_list.text: Opera became strong because of you!

text_block_list.name: Opera O's Fan
text_block_list.text:
I was able to become stronger because you 
pushed me as a rival, continuing to climb 
to greater heights together! So thank you, 
Meisho Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I was just so happy, you know? Knowing 
that maybe my presence meant something to 
Opera O-san, too...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that if I grow stronger, Opera 
O-san will become stronger too— that just 
sounded so wonderful to me.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
That's really—so, honestly... Um... 
well............

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Wh... What were we talking about 
again...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"So it's fine to keep chasing after it, 
then. Did you hear that, Shion-san?"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...If I get stronger, Orfe-san gets 
stronger too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Mmm, but with her— I kind of feel like 
she'd get strong regardless of me, you 
know?"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"It'd be amazing if we could become like 
that, though. Just like Opera O-san and 
Doto-san."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Doto-san. If it's all right with 
you, could I hear a little more of your 
story?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Fweh!?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Like, um... races that left a lasting 
impression, for example...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A-A-A race, you say?! Umm, well, uhh...—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The race... i-is gotta be the Takarazuka 
Kinen after all, right...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Back then, Opera O-san was becoming this 
solitary figure, and I wanted to support 
her... I wanted to become her rival and 
stand by her side...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"And then when I went to the paddock, 
Opera O-san told me, 'I've been waiting 
for you'..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
And then, I was just so, so happy! It gave 
me so much energy! I just ran and ran like 
a girl possessed—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I had beaten Opera O-san 
for the very first time.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...!? A-Are you crying...!? Did you hate 
it!? A-Are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, n-no! I'm sorry! I just started crying 
when I imagined how you felt...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking what a wonderful 
rivalry you two have... Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Oh my... Do you truly believe that?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Even if she never looks back, I'm sure the 
sound of her breathing still reaches her.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Take one step forward, and one steps back. 
Take two steps forward, and two more 
retreat. In an unchanging distance that 
echoes in response—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Alongside unfathomable frustration, a 
single gleaming spark... Have you never 
felt such a thing?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...That is—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Are you talking about Verxina-san...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Um, but—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense. There are only blazing hot 
flames here.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You know how much they look down on us. 
Even if we feel frustrated and irritated, 
we must never! Never...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: A-All right, I got it, I got it, I got it!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. ...I got the message, loud and 
clear.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Still, even so... if that really is the 
case, then that's pretty amazing, don't 
you think?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"It means the two of us can keep getting 
stronger together forever and ever, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...I can't believe our solo training 
overlapped at a time like this...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "U-Um... Orfe-san. If you'd like, well..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Could we spar for just one bout?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Ludicrous. You still bow your head?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Devote yourself so that you may 
serve as fine sustenance for your King.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: One lap, 2500 meters. Enter the gate.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Oh, ah! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, on a peaceful afternoon, a single, 
quietly started training match—

text_block_list.name: Shion & Orfe
text_block_list.text:
Today I'll take you down—! Today I'll 
crush you—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The more they chased after one another— 
the more it became a fierce battle 
climbing to ever greater heights."
